intro: Pick the best one. Hints are here if you want them.

items.stem: Which one calls the witness on Document 1?

options.1: Doc 1 says the Constitution made no provision for holding foreign territory or adding foreign nations
options.2: In 1803, Jefferson wrote to Breckinridge that the Constitution “has made no provision” for foreign territory
options.3: The Constitution had made no provision for holding foreign territory, which worried Jefferson a great deal
options.4: Document 1 is a letter about the Louisiana Purchase that Jefferson wrote to a man named Breckinridge

hints: One of these opens with the exact phrasing you are told never to use.
Which one tells you who and when before it tells you what?
items.reason: Option 1 uses “Doc 1 says.” Option 3 gives the evidence with no witness at all. Option 4 describes the document instead of using it. Only option 2 calls the witness and then gives the evidence.

items.stem: Which one calls the witness on Document 10?

options.1: In 1847, the Massachusetts legislature called the war one waged against a weak neighbor without just cause
options.2: Doc 10 says the war with Mexico was unnecessary and was fought without any just cause at all
options.3: The war with Mexico was unconstitutional and was begun by the order of the President to General Taylor
options.4: Document 10 is a set of resolutions from Massachusetts that were passed during the war with Mexico

hints: Who said it, and in what year?
Two of these never name who is speaking.
items.reason: Option 1 names the speaker and the year before the evidence. Option 2 uses the banned phrasing. Option 3 states the claim with no source. Option 4 describes the document rather than using it.

items.stem: Your claim is that expansion cost people their rights. Which use of a document proves that claim?

options.1: In 1830, the Cherokee Council said they were “not willing to remove” from their land (Doc 6)
options.2: In 1830, the Cherokee Council wrote an address to the people of the United States about removal (Doc 6)
options.3: In 1853, Guthrie reported that the Erie Canal had become the outlet for much of the West (Doc 3)
options.4: The Cherokee had treaties with the United States, and those treaties guaranteed where they could live

hints: Three of these call the witness properly. Only one of them proves this claim.
Option 3 is a good sentence about the wrong thing.
items.reason: Option 2 calls the witness but only names the topic — it proves an address was written, not that anyone lost a right. Option 3 proves something about canals. Option 4 has no witness. Option 1 is sourced and it proves the claim.
